Path of a file relative to the project root

Source: R/helpers.R
project_relative_path.Rd

Turns file paths back into paths relative to the project root, so they resolve from any checkout of the project. A file written through a symlink in the project (outputs pointing to shared storage, say) is usually reported by its resolved path, outside the project, where a plain relative path would have to climb out with ../.

project_relative_path(path, project = project_path())

Arguments

path

Character vector of file paths.

project

Project root directory.

Value

A character vector, one path per element of path.

Details

Each path is resolved, then mapped back by the first rule that applies:

  1. inside the project root: the path relative to it;

  2. inside the target of one of the project's top-level symlinks: that symlink's name followed by the rest of the path (the longest matching target wins);

  3. through a directory named like the project, as when shared storage is named after the project (/mnt/projects/<group>/<project>/outputs/...): the rest of the path after the deepest such directory;

  4. otherwise, the plain relative path from the project root.

A path that does not exist is normalized but not resolved.
